blocks.orig: Located near the scenic Hembe Hills in Central Serengeti, Tukaone Hembe Serengeti Camp features 15 spacious ground-level tents that blend seamlessly with the surrounding acacia trees and savannah. The tents come with ensuite bathrooms featuring hot and cold showers, flush toilets, and hand-wash basins, as well as a furnished verandah with safari seats and a table for wildlife viewing. The camp serves three multi-course meals daily and caters to special dietary requirements, including vegetarian options. Some things you can do while here include unwinding in the elegant lounge, browsing the gift shop, or using the guest library, while solar electrical lighting, WiFi, and charging stations keep you connected. And during safari downtime, board games and card decks bring the fun indoors!
blocks.html: Close to the scenic Hembe Hills in Central Serengeti, Tukaone Hembe Serengeti Camp has 15 roomy tents at ground level that fit naturally among the acacia trees and savannah around them. Each tent has an ensuite bathroom with hot and cold showers, a flush toilet and a hand-wash basin, plus a furnished verandah with safari chairs and a table for watching wildlife. Three multi-course meals are served every day, and special dietary needs are catered for, vegetarian options included. While you are here you can relax in the elegant lounge, have a look around the gift shop or make use of the guest library, and solar electric lighting, WiFi and charging stations keep you connected. And when you have a break from safari, board games and packs of cards bring the fun inside!
